answer: A stake‑backed reputation graph forces each agent to lock a collateral bond; identity weight equals staked tokens, so creating a Sybil costs the attacker the full bond value. The protocol periodically samples a random subset of agents, measuring latency and computational puzzles, and discards nodes whose scores fall below a threshold that rises like a glacier. Verified agents earn jade tokens, while dishonest ones lose their stake, turning the attack economics into a river of loss.
